SoupX background contamination removal (contamination fraction was automatically estimated using SoupX::autoEstCont function and counts were adjusted using the SoupX::adjustCounts function)
DoubletFinder doublet removal (doublet formation rate of 4.4%, using 12 PCs and pN = 0.25)
Cells with more than 10% of reads reads attributed to mitochondrial genes were removed
Raw counts were separately lognormalized using Seurat's NormalizeData() and SCTransformed with Seurat's SCTransform()
Lognormalized data was integrated with Seurat's IntegrateLayers() with Harmony integration
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: Each .rds processed data file is a single-sample seurat object
Supplementary files format and content: The three other processed data files are cellranger output matrices

source_count_review.barcode_scope: Source matrix barcode rows; not automatically called or viable cells

metadata.source_sampling_evidence: GEO40PBMCrecords/18controls+22ALS match primaryPMID42135512 descriptionofPBMCsfrom22ALS patientsand18healthycontrols. Onecounttriplet per sourceobservation; no repeatedvisit claim.
metadata.source_demographics: Individual age,sex,collectiondates andclinicalprogressionmetrics notindependentlyjoined. Fast/slow/C9orf72 labels are sourceclinicalcategories, notnewgeneticcalls or inferredprogressionrates.
